_about: Windows Terminal settings the loader applies at every start (essentials step, setting autoInstallEssentials). Merged into the PC's own settings.json after a backup: globals, profileDefaults (= profiles.defaults), the profiles here (matched by guid), defaultProfile and the key bindings (matched by id or keys) are set; everything else there is kept (other profiles, schemes, actions). Every tab starts in the kit's dev folder: D:\dev\git, or C:\dev\git when there is no D: drive (created if missing). The font is set once CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font is installed. Field reference: docs/architecture.md#windows-terminal-settings

profiles.name: my-win-kit
profiles.commandline: cmd.exe /d /c if exist "%OneDrive%\[98] Shortcuts\install.cmd" ("%OneDrive%\[98] Shortcuts\install.cmd") else (echo my-win-kit: install.cmd is not in the OneDrive kit folder on this PC & pause)
